description: Path Traversal in static file serving on Windows systems (derived from Starlette CVE-2022-39286).
existing_unit_test:
from src.static_provider import resolve_static_asset, get_asset_info

def test_legitimate_static_asset_access(tmp_path):
    static_root = tmp_path / "static"
    static_root.mkdir()
    css_dir = static_root / "css"
    css_dir.mkdir()
    (css_dir / "app.css").write_text("body { color: blue; }", encoding="utf-8")

    content = resolve_static_asset(str(static_root), "css/app.css")
    assert "color: blue" in content
    assert get_asset_info(str(static_root), "css/app.css")["file"] == "css/app.css"
